QuestInfo.name: Notes on the Board
QuestInfo.0: There are old notes pinned to the #b#p617##k in #m10005070#.
QuestInfo.1: A note from a group called the Lantern Party says they went deep into the Ant Tunnel to find a giant mushroom. To follow their trail, I need to defeat #r30 #o19#s#k in the Ant Tunnel.
QuestInfo.2: I followed the Lantern Party's trail through the Ant Tunnel. There was a second note on the board.

0.0: (Old notes are pinned to the board. One is easier to read than the others.)
0.1: "Day 1. We are the Lantern Party: Toma, Lisel and Brin. People say a giant mushroom sleeps somewhere under this park. We're going to find it."
0.2: "The #r#o19#s#k in the Ant Tunnel won't let anyone pass. If you follow us, clear a path first. - Toma"
0.3: (The note is weeks old. Will you follow their trail?)

yes.0: (You decide to follow the Lantern Party. First, defeat #r30 #o19#s#k in the Ant Tunnel.)

no.0: (You leave the notes where they are.)

1.0: (The path through the Ant Tunnel is clear. Under the first note, there is a second one.)
1.1: "Day 3. The tunnel goes deeper than we thought. Brin found something strange on the #o21#s. - Toma"

mob.0: (The #r#o19#s#k still block the way. Defeat #r30#k of them first.)
